rules.title: Component renders both multi-line and single-line variants
rules.notes: Two variants detected in manifest: Type=Multi-Line, Type=Single-Line. Both implemented.

rules.title: Multi-line variant includes tab bar with language switching
rules.notes: Tab bar uses role=tablist and role=tab pattern. Language tabs: Java (active), Python, C, C++, HTML, PHP.

rules.title: Multi-line variant includes line numbers gutter
rules.notes: Line numbers are presentational. aria-hidden=true applied.

rules.title: Code content is inside <pre><code>
rules.notes: Manifest shows plain TEXT layer. Implementation uses <pre><code> for semantic correctness. Intentional deviation documented.

rules.title: Copy button has accessible label
rules.notes: Copy button is icon-only. aria-label='Copy code' required. Implemented.

rules.title: Show More button uses aria-expanded
rules.notes: aria-expanded toggled by JS. Default: false.

rules.title: Tab bar implements role=tablist / role=tab ARIA pattern
rules.notes: role=tablist on wrapper, role=tab on each button, aria-selected, aria-controls, tabindex=-1 on inactive tabs.

rules.title: Code panel implements role=tabpanel
rules.notes: Each code panel is role=tabpanel with aria-labelledby pointing to its tab.

rules.title: Line numbers are aria-hidden
rules.notes: Line number column is presentational. aria-hidden=true prevents screen reader interference.

rules.title: Focus indicators are visible on interactive elements
rules.notes: :focus-visible outline applied to tab buttons, copy button, and show more button.

rules.title: Keyboard navigation between tabs uses arrow keys
rules.notes: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move focus and activate tabs per ARIA Authoring Practices Guide.

rules.title: Component CSS uses component-level semantic tokens only
rules.notes: All --code-snippet-* tokens are used in CSS. No primitive token leakage. Tokens are proposed and not yet in token.css.

rules.title: No hardcoded color, spacing, or radius values in component CSS
rules.notes: All visual values use CSS custom properties with fallbacks. No hex/rgba/px literals in component selectors.

rules.title: Active tab state is visually and semantically distinct
rules.notes: Active tab: font-weight 700, --code-snippet-tab-active-text-color, green ::after bottom indicator.

rules.title: Focus ring is implemented using :focus-visible
rules.notes: :focus-visible used for keyboard-only focus. Mouse click does not show focus ring.
